title: Larkspur home-office stipend policy
brief: People Operations at Larkspur Analytics needs a policy page for the new home-office stipend, effective 2027-01-01, so employees can find the rules without opening tickets. Headings: "Who is covered", "What you get", "What you can buy", "How to claim" and "What is not covered". Who is covered: all employees who work at least 3 days a week from home, after 90 days of service; part-time employees receive 50 percent. What you get: a one-time setup stipend of 500 dollars, plus 40 dollars a month toward internet and phone, and the setup stipend can be used again after 3 years. What you can buy: a desk, chair, monitor, keyboard, headset and lighting. How to claim: submit receipts in the expense portal within 60 days of purchase; purchases over 250 dollars need written manager approval beforehand; reimbursement arrives within 10 business days. Not covered: gaming equipment, furniture for non-work use, software subscriptions and anything already supplied by the company. Questions go to finance-help@larkspur.example or the #finance-help channel. Plain, friendly language.

edit.request: Raise the one-time setup stipend to 650 dollars and shorten the claim window to 45 days.
